anchor.description: Model centre (coordinate origin); chosen at the midpoint of OSM way 30657925

osm_offset_m.note: OSM here was traced from GDA94-era imagery and sits ~1.5 m SW of the 2019 LiDAR, DTM and aerial photo (all GDA2020). Shifting OSM by the GDA94->GDA2020 difference raises its overlap with LiDAR roofs from IoU 0.38 to 0.42; Microsoft footprints and imagery need no shift.
